close_reason: not_found_json always returns Array; fixed snippet.rs+vacation.rs inline null patterns; 6 chat-server tests updated to assert []
description: RFC 8620 §5.1 requires the notFound field in /get responses to be a String[] (possibly empty []), never null. jmap-test-suite tests get-not-found (Email/get, Mailbox/get, Thread/get, Identity/get) assert notFound is an array. Audit all get handlers in jmap-mail-server and the generic handle_get in jmap-server: verify they always return notFound as [] when nothing is missing, not null or absent.
title: jmap-mail-server: notFound must be [] not null in get handlers
